## About
North Texas Chiropractic treats back, neck, muscle and joint pain without drugs or surgery. Our doctors look for the source of your pain and build a treatment plan that combines chiropractic care with physical therapy, so you can get back to work or your sport with less pain.
Whether you're an airline employee, office worker, athlete or student, we see people whose bodies are worn down by everyday life. We have a long history of treating American Airlines employees, and we see patients for auto injuries, sports injuries, headaches, tendonitis, carpal tunnel and more.
You'll find us just off Justin Rd, behind Lantana Family Dentistry and Lantana Animal Hospital. Patients have rated us 4.8 from 37 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chiropractic care: Spinal adjustments to find the cause of your symptoms and help your body heal naturally.
- Physical therapy: Stretching, exercise and muscle work to rehabilitate aches, pains and reduced function.
- Sports and auto injury rehab: Treatment and rehab for injuries from a car accident or from the sport you love.
- Massage therapy: Massage therapy as part of your visit, alongside your adjustment and other treatments.

## FAQ
Q: Can I be seen the same day I call?
A: In most cases, yes. Our doctors can usually see and treat you on the same day you call to schedule.

Q: Do I have to sign up for a long-term care plan?
A: No. We don't use long-term care plans or ask for large up-front out-of-pocket payments.

Q: Where exactly is the office?
A: We're behind Lantana Family Dentistry and Lantana Animal Hospital. Google Maps works best for directions. Waze may send you to the wrong area.
